results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: News article reporting on research led by Fabio Giglietto analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts to examine how Meta's algorithms reduced visibility for elected officials while extremist content gained reach, prompting European Parliament inquiries and TV coverage.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press and news coverage highlighting findings by Professor Fabio Giglietto on Meta's Political Content Reduction Policy and its impact on Italian parliamentarians, which spurred a parliamentary question in the EU and inspired an investigative report on Rai3's 'Report'.
